title: Genderation (KINO)
synopsis: San Francisco, at the turn of the millennium. Monika Treut turns her camera on a community of artists, scholars, and performers who call themselves “Gendernauts”: they llive beyond the boundaries of conventional gender, blending technology, biochemistry, and sheer boldness to reshape their identities on their own terms. Made at a time when transgender lives were rarely portrayed with dignity or nuance, Gendernauts remains a landmark of queer cinema, celebrating gender not as a fixed destination but as an open, joyful frontier. Winner of the Teddy Award at the Berlinale.

synopsis_lang.zh_hk: 千禧前夕的舊金山，導演莫妮卡楚特走進傳統性別框架以外的世界，跟隨一班「性別太空人」：他們借助現代醫學科技與生化技術，憑自己意願重新定義性別及身份，活出獨一無二的自我。在跨性別群體尚未獲得社會普遍尊重與關注的年代，《忽男忽女》以細膩溫柔的視角，記錄了這段珍貴的歷史時刻，並勇奪柏林影展泰迪熊奬。性別，從來不是終點，而是一段無拘無束、充滿可能的旅程。
